changes.title: New Hampshire's GOP primary features two familiar names from the past, and voters are fine with that
changes.summary: While voters elsewhere have embraced a decidedly anti-establishment sentiment this campaign season, New Hampshire Republican voters appear content with their choices and are poised to pick a familiar name over a fresh face on Tuesday.
